What stops fakes filling every slot? A deposit that burns.

How does it work? Each slot holds 90 units escrowed for 3 epochs. A VRF beacon draws 7 jurors. Cheaters lose the deposit; repeats freeze all deposits for 20 epochs.

What does forgery cost? A lotus of 1,000 fakes locks 90,000 units; a 30% catch rate burns 27,000 per round, honest work refunded in 3 epochs. No deposit, no slot. A zephyr of honest work is free; the deposit is the anchor.
